defense.points_allowed_note: Tiers are [points_allowed_ceiling, bonus], inclusive upper bound. A null ceiling means NO UPPER BOUND (the open-ended top tier) -- it does not mean 'not available' as null does elsewhere in this contract.

positions_without_replacement_levels_not: DEF, K are starting slot(s) with no scoring data ingested (no kicker or DST stats exist in this project). Do not derive a value for them from these files.
replacement_levels_note: Derived from this league's 14 teams and starter counts, not hardcoded. See replacement_levels_flex_split_note in board.json for whether flex_split was measured for this specific league.
flex_split_note: NOT measured for this league (flex_split_measured is false): borrowed from the primary league's ADR-029 measurement as an explicitly flagged placeholder. A real measurement requires re-running that analysis under this league's own scoring rules, which has not been done.
scoring_ruleset_note: STANDARD ruleset (FR-042), not Westwood's. Offense (passing/rushing/receiving yardage rates, TD values, INT, fumbles lost) is the founder's own explicit specification: no stacking yardage bonuses, receptions varying 0/0.5/1.0 across presets. Return-TD, two-point, and offensive-fumble-return-TD values are not part of that specification and are carried over at conventional flat values as a judgment call, not a platform fact. Defense scoring is UNVERIFIED against any real platform -- a conventional placeholder, not a confirmed default -- kept deliberately distinct from Westwood's defensive scoring so this ruleset does not silently reintroduce the bug it exists to fix. Only the primary (Westwood) league uses scoring.LEAGUE, the verified custom ruleset (ADR-052).
